objects.name: Shai-Hulud strikes again: CHAINDROP worm hits 400+ npm packages
objects.description: Elastic Security Labs identified the return of Shai-Hulud. Attackers compromised the keyv maintainer and deployed CHAINDROP, a worm that uses stolen npm credentials to backdoor co-owned packages totaling over 1.3 billion monthly downloads.
